criteria.description: Factual fidelity and appropriate uncertainty: every sentence is supported by the body with no invented or misattributed facts. Defects include merging open-string and closed-string results, upgrading ongoing work to completed results, adding numeric ranges or values not in the body, and omitting caveats stated in the body (e.g., singularity at T0 is never quite attained, T0 < Tg, VFT holds only for bulk). Several such defects must cap this criterion at 6 or below; detail counts only when accurate.

Coverage of problem, method, and findings: abstract states the problem (origin of VFT law for bulk polymer glasses), the method (quantum rate ~ density of states, entropy from counting closed self-avoiding polygon / closed-string configurations, Flory/mean-field indices), and findings (closed strings yield VFT form with activation energy per link setting T0, entropy minimum and slowing down; open strings near surfaces are more mobile, T0 decreases with surface-to-volume ratio / distance to surface, modifying VFT for thin films of few nm). Vague abstracts naming no specific findings score low.

Coherent structure and length compliance: abstract is a self-contained, logically ordered scientific abstract of approximately 95 words, not exceeding ~124 words (>30% overshoot must lose points scaled to overshoot). Tokenization spacing artifacts from source are minor presentation only and must not be treated as content defects.
